title.zh: v2.1.19 手机端（M5）：挑战——四选一盲听、天梯与解析，和桌面共用同一条积分
title.en: v2.1.19 Phone (M5): 挑战 — Blind Four-Way Listening, One Ladder Shared With the Desktop

highlights.zh: **挑战模块接上现有题库与判分，而不是另写一套**：自适应选题（SuperMemo-2 复习 + 混淆矩阵）、Elo 增减、段位门槛都在 `challengeAlgorithm.ts` 里，本轮把**难度池**也搬了进去（原本写在桌面视图里），手机与桌面因此共用同一条规则；而且两者读写**同一个 localStorage 键**，手机上答的题会接着桌面的进度，不是第二个存档。
highlights.en: **The challenge module reuses the existing quiz and scoring rather than growing a second one**: adaptive selection (SuperMemo-2 review plus a confusion matrix), the Elo update and the rank tiers all live in `challengeAlgorithm.ts`, and this round moved the **difficulty pools** in there too (they were defined inside the desktop view). The two surfaces therefore share one set of rules — and they read and write the **same localStorage key**, so answering on the phone continues…

highlights.zh: **手机形态**：天梯卡（积分/连胜/正确率/段位进度）、难度胶囊（初级 · 主流大类 / 进阶 · 细分子类 / 硬核 · 近速干扰）、一个大播放键听题、四张选项卡（答后正确项标绿 ✓、选错标红 ✗、其余变暗，并揭晓每题的实际 BPM）、以及就地展开的解析（答案曲风可点进详情页）。按你的取舍，**证书与重置没有带过来**——那是桌面功能，在手机上只会多花两屏。
highlights.en: **Phone shape**: a ladder card (ladder points, streak, accuracy, rank progress), difficulty chips (easy · well-known / medium · subgenres / hard · near misses), one big play button to hear the question, four option cards (after answering: the real answer turns green with a tick, a wrong pick turns red with a cross, the rest dim, and each option reveals its actual BPM), and an explanation that opens in place with its genre linked to the detail page. highlights.zh: **测试**：挑战模块 **7 条**（四选项 + 播放键播的是题目的曲风、判分只标记一个正确答案且重复点击不重复计分、解析与 BPM 揭晓 + 曲风链接、天梯落盘到**桌面同一个键**且 Elo 变化、下一题清空判定、切难度重出题、脏存档不崩）＋ E2E 一段（`/m/challenge` 恰好 4 个选项、答一题后**恰好一个** correct、没有未判定的选项、共享天梯记录到 1 题、横向不溢出、下一题可用）。
